standing: PROPOSED description-only D2b4a successor; independent design-unit review/root assent required

passageOverrides.before: Dispatch the selected provider wire protocol and validate its transaction boundaries.
passageOverrides.after: Dispatch the selected provider wire protocol and validate transaction boundaries. Accepted D2b-4a exposes the Rust3 base receive codec beside TS2 and shares the exact validated profile proof with the immutable codec context. Rust3 sender/participant, FA-2/LIM successors and production caller wiring remain separate; this module establishes no product qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-1: the strict ts2-cbor and rust3-cbor profiles (shortest heads, sorted unique text keys, no tags, floats, indefinite lengths or non-NFC text, an iterative depth bound) with spanned decoding and the deterministic encoder.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D D2b-1 and accepted D2b-4a: strict ts2-cbor/rust3-cbor profiles with shortest heads, sorted unique text keys, no tags/floats/indefinite lengths/non-NFC text, iterative depth-bounded spanned decoding and deterministic encoding. Checked iterative encoded_length measures the complete CBOR value without copying output so Rust3 response/wrapper accounting precedes retained conversion; it is not a universal allocation-free claim or a new payload limit.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3a (LD-D2B3-1): the carrier-typed closed check of TS2's inherited frames, interpreting the native-carriers-v1 records and refusing at load any form, order, pattern or lexical rule it does not implement, and the admission of extern payloads by their product schemas through the embedded registry.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3a/4a shared closed carrier interpreter and embedded product-schema admission. Selected native-carriers-v1 forms, orders, lexical rules and patterns must be implemented at load. Rust3-only grammar additions cover its aliases, optional members, bool/integer/text restrictions, concrete lexical forms and orders; the TS2 namespace retains its existing restrictions. Rust3 contextual joins, commitments and owner-specific admission remain in their respective consumers; this shared checker confers no H/Plan/fact authority or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: Supply the provider codecs' payload schema checks with the selected schema registry from compiled exact raw schema documents (the same files storage embeds, in the pinned order), compiled once per process; RegisteredSchemas::from_sources refuses any absent, extra, reordered or replaced source; no runtime path lookup or ambient I/O; M3-D unit D2b-3a.
passageOverrides.after: Supply provider codecs with the one process-wide immutable registry compiled from exact raw schema documents in pinned order. RegisteredSchemas::from_sources refuses absent/extra/reordered/replaced sources. Accepted D2b-4a also exposes the immutable selected schema graph internally for source-derived Rust3 schema-work pricing; admission uses the same owned registry and evaluator. No runtime lookup, ambient I/O, alias expansion or separate schema policy is introduced.

passageOverrides.before: Interpret the selected exact schema profile with bounded work and distinct mismatch, schema fault and limit outcomes; keep the interpreter private.
passageOverrides.after: Interpret the selected exact schema profile with checked bounded work and distinct mismatch, schema fault and limit outcomes; keep the interpreter private. Accepted D2b-4a adds structured-value admission through the same evaluator, with full precharge before recursive NFC/model checks and owned copying and the same NFC/integer/opaque-shape semantics. The existing JSON-input limit remains unchanged; this does not select a second schema owner or a universal wire payload cap.

passageOverrides.before: Bind exact full-document source pins, local reference closure, explicit current aliases and opaque shape handles; historical readers and semantic joins remain separate.
passageOverrides.after: Bind exact full-document source pins, local reference closure, explicit current aliases and opaque shape handles. Accepted D2b-4a routes structured values through that same registry/interpreter with checked full precharge; the components codec derives schema work from its immutable exact source set. Historical readers and semantic joins remain separate; no new alias, runtime source or admission authority is selected.

passageOverrides.before: Exercise exact schema keywords, custom ordering, reference and pattern semantics, and non-invertible refusal categories.
passageOverrides.after: Exercise exact schema keywords, custom ordering, reference and pattern semantics, and non-invertible refusal categories. Accepted D2b-4a adds structured-value controls for the same schema owner, NFC/integer/opaque-shape handling and checked precharge before recursive work, retaining the JSON-input boundary controls. These controls establish no new schema owner, payload policy or product qualification.
